images.filename: USS Bayfield (APA-33) at Charleston, South Carolina (USA), on 4 January 1950 (NH 99242).jpg
images.caption: The U.S. Navy attack transport USS Bayfield (APA-33) at Charleston, South Carolina (USA), on 4 January 1950. She was proceeding to Pier D-5 at the Charleston Naval Shipyard to embark troops of the Third Division, from Fort Benning, Georgia (USA), to participate in "Operation Portrex - Korean War". Note the unusual radar antenna forward.
